text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali is in Lisbon at the invitation of James Baker, the United Nations special envoy in Western Sahara.
- Crown Prince Mohamed attends United Nations Earth Summit in New York.
- Belgium grants Morocco 310 million dirhams ($32.8 million) for water projects.
- Old guard opposition Istiqlal party heads 204 local councils.
- General Confederation of Moroccan Businesses (CGEM) to appoint new president on July 3.
- Head of Moroccan agency for the development of northern provinces visits the European Commission to discuss priorities and potential help.
